title: a readable serve status that names no proxy target: unknown, never pass and never blocked
titleZh: serve status 可读但没有可解析的 proxy 目标:unknown,既不 pass 也不 blocked
why: t23: a readable CLI answer without a proxy target carries no evidence about where serve points, and the listener shape is explicitly not evidence (see fault-serve-target-port-mismatch). The clean baseline does carry a tailscaled 443 row in netstat, yet the verdict must stay unknown - the collector refuses to turn an unparsable answer into either a pass or a fault. This is exactly the shape a mistranslated or newer CLI wording would produce, which is when guessing has to stop.
inject: tailscale serve status exits 0 with 'No serve config' (no proxy target line) on the otherwise clean server baseline
expectSummary: SERVE_PRESENT unknown/serve_unknown, manualReview=true, never pass/degraded/blocked, exit != 0
